top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 140, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Pickerel Buck40's wI rolling gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Pickerel Buck40's WI countryside, Rolling gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 140 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Pickerel Buck40's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Pickerel Buck40. Train it until it feels boring.
At Pickerel Buck40, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on wI rolling gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
140 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 140 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Pickerel Buck40's wI rolling gravel actually does to you.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Pickerel Buck40, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 140 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Pickerel Buck40’s 140 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Pickerel Buck40 requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on wi rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: wi countryside, rolling gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 140 miles of wi rolling gravel in Wisconsin.
